column1: # Same Bluehost account/SSH key for all. rsync has no --delete — it only
# adds/updates, never removes files already on the server.
# As of 2026-09-03 the hubs are served from CLOUDFLARE PAGES, not Bluehost —
# the Bluehost plan is at its 50-website cap and the account is a mess. One
# Pages project ("dash-hubs") holds every hub as a subdir and routes each
# custom domain to its subdir by Host header (web/hub/_worker.js). Deploy:
# web/hub/CLOUDFLARE-ROUTING.md. Bluehost keeps the mail (MX stays on Bluehost).
# creative-flow-guitar → creativeflowguitar.com is still served the OLD way
# from ~/creativeflowguitar.com and stays here — it works; migrate to Cloudflare
# later if wanted (it's already in the _worker.js HUBS map).
